title: Shindo Noa face search, operator's own exploration prompt
user_request_verbatim: 어제까지의 삽질을 바탕으로 새로운 캐릭터를 만든거야. 노아가 잘 되면 그 방식을 이용해서 다른 캐릭터들을 수정할 수 있겠지만 그건 노아가 잘 될 때의 이야기야. 즉 노아를 이용해서 시작해줘
source_idea: The operator rewrote the DNA overnight with what the Lia work established: an off-prior eye anchor (visible sclera, short brow-to-eye distance), a dedicated profile field, an explicit forbidden_drift list and explicit flexible_variables. This runs their own Loose Krea exploration prompt verbatim, with no negative prompt, because a broad negative list is what made the previous grid plain rather than distinctive.
